title: Account cadence deck lab: quarterly playback + renewal ops
body:
PURPOSE:
This is a working lab for a pair of Quarterly Playback (QPR) deck templates and a compact renewal ops tracker designed for CS managers running both standard (SMB/volume) and enterprise (strategic) cadences. The goal: make meeting prep repeatable, reduce variance across reps, and create a one-click follow-up checklist after each customer meeting.

AUDIENCE & DURATION:
- Standard variant: CSM + Customer champions, 30–45 minutes, operational focus (adoption, blockers, next milestones).
- Enterprise variant: CSM + Customer execs + Technical sponsor, 45–60 minutes, strategic focus (business outcomes, ROI, renewal motion).

HOW TO USE THIS LAB:
1) Make a copy of the appropriate slide deck for the customer.
2) Fill the front-matter: ARR/contract dates, renewal window, point of contact, and current health signals.
3) Use the slide-by-slide speaker notes below; adapt to customer maturity.
4) After the meeting, update the Renewal Tracker row and run the Post-Meeting Checklist.

TEMPLATE OVERVIEW (high-level differences)
- Standard deck: concise (8–10 slides), action-oriented, emphasizes adoption metrics, top 3 risks, immediate next 90-day milestones. Good for volume accounts and renewal windows under $50k.
- Enterprise deck: expanded (12–16 slides), includes ROI overview, technical roadmap alignment, exec ask slide, stakeholder map, and escalation play. Intended for renewals > $50k and multi-team contracts.

SLIDE-BY-SLIDE (STANDARD VARIANT)
1) Title slide: Customer name, CSM, date, next renewal date (one-liner).
2) Agenda & desired outcomes: 3 bullets (alignment).
3) Current contract snapshot: ARR, term, renewal window, billing cadence (single slide).
4) Adoption snapshot (top KPIs): DAU/MAU analog, feature usage %, key success metrics vs target. Speaker note: call out 1 positive metric + 1 gap.
5) Recent wins (last 90 days): quick bullets with owner & date.
6) Active blockers & risks (ranked): 3 rows with owner and ETA.
7) Recommended short-term plan (next 90 days): 3 prioritized actions and owners.
8) Renewal posture & ask: timeline for commercial conversation, suggested steps for EBR/exec intro if needed.
9) Action register & owners: the output slide for meeting minutes.

SLIDE-BY-SLIDE (ENTERPRISE VARIANT)
1) Title + Meeting context: business outcome focus.
2) Full agenda + time allocation (split by stakeholder).
3) Executive summary: 1-page narrative of health + renewal posture.
4) Contract & commercial snapshot: ARR, add-ons, multi-year elements, PO cadence.
5) Business outcomes & ROI progress: quantifiable adoption -> business metric correlation.
6) Technical alignment & roadmap risks: integrations, SSO, performance SLOs.
7) Stakeholder map: sponsor, champions, blockers, exec sponsor.
8) Risk matrix & mitigation plan (likelihood x impact).
9) Strategic opportunities (upsell/expansion hypothesis + business value).
10) Renewal timeline & commercial asks: who, when, next steps for procurement.
11) Escalation path & SLAs: internal contact points and escalation trigger criteria.
12) Meeting actions & RACI.
13) Appendix: runbooks, relevant support tickets, open feature requests.

SPEAKER NOTES (snippets to drop into slide notes)
- Opening: "We’ll spend 45 minutes on adoption and how your goals for X map to the roadmap; at the end we’ll align on next steps and a renewal timeline"
- When presenting risks: "This is the most material blocker we see today; suggested mitigation is... We’ll assign an owner and target date."
- Closing ask (enterprise): "To keep roadmap alignment and ensure uninterrupted rollout, we recommend an executive touchpoint in the next 30 days and a procurement timeline of X weeks."

RENEWAL TRACKER (compact text table to paste into the CS tracker sheet)
Format header: Account | ARR | Renewal window | Current health | Risk level | CSM | Next milestone | Notes
Example row (one-line): Acme Retail | $120,000 | 2026-07-15 | 78/100 (growth signs) | Medium | Priya Nair | Integration go-live 2026-04-30 | Exec intro planned, pilot success metrics hit 82%
Example row (one-line): GreenGrid Labs | $32,500 | 2026-05-02 | 62/100 (usage dip) | High | Marco Ruiz | Weekly enablement 2026-03-20 | Open perf ticket TK-112, finance hold for PO

POST-MEETING CHECKLIST (automated email + tracker steps)
- Capture meeting minutes in slide "Action register & owners" within 24 hours.
- Update Renewal Tracker row with new health, committed actions and updated risk.
- Create or link Jira/SRV tickets for any technical blocker mentioned.
- Send meeting recap email with explicit owner/time commitments and calendar invites for next checkpoints.
- If risk is High: trigger the 1:1 escalation play (CS Manager -> AE -> Customer Exec sponsor).

RISK SIGNALS & PLAYBOOK (observable signals to watch)
- Usage signal: rolling 30-day active seats drop >15% -> auto-run adoption outreach.
- Support volume: >3 Sev2 incidents in 30 days -> evaluate health and offer remediation call.
- Procurement stall: no PO movement 30 days after commercial terms agreed -> AE & CSM coordinate procurement support.
- Exec silence: invitations to strategic EBR ignored twice -> escalate to CS Manager for exec bridge.

ESCALATION RUNS (short-run playbook)
1) Triage: CSM updates tracker + posts in #cs-escalations Slack channel with TL;DR and link to deck.
2) Fix-it workshop: SWAT call with engineering/product (max 48 hours).
3) Exec bridge: schedule a 30-minute call with customer exec + Redwood exec sponsor (CS Manager coordinates).
4) Commercial contingency: prepare an interim contract amendment if remediation requires timeline adjustments.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS (what to track across cadences)
- Time from meeting -> actions captured (target <24h).
- Percent of actions completed by target date (target >85%).
- Renewal outcome (retained/expanded/contracted) at renewal window.
- Health score delta 90-days post-playbook application (target +10 points).

CUSTOMIZABLE SLIDE SNIPPETS (copy/paste friendly)
- "Top 3 wins: 1) Onboarded X teams, 2) Reduced time-to-answer by Y%, 3) Integration shipped."
- "Top 3 blockers: 1) SSO delay (owner), 2) Data mapping gap (owner), 3) Invoicing question (owner)."
- Email subject template: "[Customer] Quarterly Playback + Actions — {date} — {CSM name}"
- Slack post template to #cs-escalations: "Escalation: {Account} risk=High; short summary + link to slide deck + ask"

NOTES TO TEAM (open questions and next steps for this lab)
- Should we add a 1-slide legal/procurement checklist for enterprise decks? (ask Legal/Finance).
- Consider adding a one-click sheet export that populates the Renewal Tracker row from slides. Engineering feasibility TBD.
- Next iteration: baseline slide with a 6-month health trend chart and automated data pull from observability.

APPENDIX: WORKSHEET COPY (paste ready)
- Title: Meeting front-matter: Customer, CSM, AE, Renewal date, ARR, Contract owner.
- 90-day plan: 3 actions; owner; due date.
- Risk register: 3 rows: risk, owner, mitigation, ETA.

KEEPING THIS DOC CURRENT
- Owner: Priya Nair (CS Playbooks).
- Please add comments inline; tag @Lian if you want changes to the enterprise escalation language.

END: this is a working draft — expect iterative changes. Add feedback as inline comments or link pull requests to CS-4821."
